- 80 PLUS® GOLD認証
- 最新のATX12 V3.0準拠 & EPS12V V2.92
- 新しい12V HPWR コネクタ
- 90%以上の高い変換効率
- 高温多湿な環境に対応する「Off-Wetテクノロジー」

- 静音性、耐久性の高い120mm 流体軸受けファン

## 新しいATX PSUの仕様

次世代ハードウェアの電力需要に対応するためにATX 3.0の仕様を更新し、ユーザーが最高の電力効率で可能な限り安定・最適化されたコストパフォーマンスを得られるようにしました。 詳しくはこちらをご覧ください。.

## 高電力互換性により最大のパフォーマンスが得られます

PCIe 5.0 ネイティブ コネクタと、グラフィックス カード用の最大 3 セットの PCIe 6+2Pin コネクタと 2 セットの CPU コネクタのサポートにより、システム パフォーマンスが向上します。 この高度なソリューションは、最大のパワーと速度を提供し、コンピューティング エクスペリエンスを向上させます。

# Hydro G PRO ATX3.0(PCIe5.0) 850W

- 符合ATX3.0 &PCIe-5.0标准
- 高效率 ≧ 90%
- 智能温控风扇
- 静音耐用120mm FDB风扇
- +5V & 3.3V DC to DC直流转换
- +12V 单路电力设计
- 日式电解电容
- 为DIY爱好者和游戏发烧友提供个性化贴纸
- 适用于恶劣环境的保形涂层
- 多重保护：OCP、OVP、SCP、OPP、OTP

## 新的ATX 电源规格

针对下一代硬件电源需求更新了ATX 3.0规范，确保用户以最高的电源效率获得尽可能稳定和成本优化的性能。 单击此处了解更多详细信息。

## 高功率兼容性释放最大性能

配备PCIe 5.0接口增强系统性能，并支持最多3个用于显卡的PCIe 6+2pin接口以及2个CPU连接器。这一先进的解决方案可提供最大的功率和速度，提升您的计算体验。

...

# 遵守IEC/EN 62368

FSP集团采用最新的绿色电力技术，并提供各种额外的安全批准，使设计领先于不断变化的法规。FSP已将大部分电源升级为适用于您游戏设备的新IEC/EN 62368标准。

# 80 Plus®金牌认证

Hydro G Pro系列是一款获得80 PLUS®金牌认证的电源，可保证在PSU额定功率的50%负载下以至少90%的效率运行，从而降低大量电力成本。

# ECO开关，更安静、更持久的风扇

当Eco按钮打开时，您可以根据自己的需要调整按钮，使其更容易在低功耗和静音的情况下运行。当电源处于30%负载静音状态时，电源中的风扇将不工作。

# 与最新的PC技术兼容

与各种最新的CPU平台完全对应。符合Intel ATX12V V3.0电源设计指南，确保12V峰值功率支持最新的Intel和AMD平台，并为您的PC系统提供全功率。

# 多单元连接器

ATX 12V CPU电源连接器能够支持足够功率的CPU。Hydro G PRO系列从850W到1200W封装2 x 4+4引脚电源连接器，比常规PSU多，并为您的新配置提供所需的稳定和峰值输出。

# FSP UNVEILS THE LATEST ATX 3.0 PSU RANGE READY TO HIT THE SHELVES SOON

2022-10-06

## Brand new power delivery and safety features tailored to support the latest RTX 40 series graphic cards

6 th October 2022, Taipei, Taiwan - FSP Group, one of the world's leading high-performance OEM and ODM power supply manufacturers today, unveils the next Generation ATX 3.0 Power supply lineup, carrying the latest PCIe Gen 5 interface.

...

Focused on increasing the efficiency and reliability of their power supplies, FSP has mastered the ATX Version 3.0 (ATX 3.0) Multi- Rail power supply design guide from Intel, built to cater to the higher-power demand of the latest hardware. The newly upgraded FSP power supplies are tailor-made to extract the best performance from the next-generation technology, including the NVIDIA RTX 4000 series, to AMD’S RX 7000-series power-hungry graphics cards.

The HYDRO G PRO power supplies equipped with the new ATX3.0 upgrade will be the first to hit the shelves, followed by HYDRO PTM PRO, HYDROGT PRO, and the HYDRO PTM X PRO, respectively. They are available in Gold and Platinum rated variants ranging from 800W (850W) up to 1200W.

Additionally, the SFX form factor DAGGER PRO series 850W and 1000W power supplies designed with PCIe Gen 5 & V4.0 compliance will be ready to launch in Q4 this year together with FSP's brand new HYDRO Ti PRO ATX 3.0 PSU. The HYDRO Ti PRO is the first ATX 3.0 & PCIe Gen 5 PSU engineered with Titanium efficiency, available in 850W and 1000W.

 

These new power supplies carry the latest 12VHPWR power connector designed to deliver up to 600W of raw, unhindered power to the graphics card. With completely isolated terminals for added protection, they come fully remastered to handle the dramatic power spikes that many of the newer high-end graphic cards draw on max load.

...

In conclusion, the new ATX 3.0 (PCIe5.0) power supplies will undoubtedly become the new standard requirement for high-end systems. They are designed with higher power efficiency and strategic features to support gamers, creators, deep learning data scientists, etc., who might experience constant power spikes and to extract maximum performance from any graphics card. FSP group's ATX 3.0 PSU range looks to redefine the market trend once again with innovative power delivery and next-level safety features designed to empower the beastly graphic cards of the next generation. They highly recommend that users upgrade their power supplies if they plan to buy a new graphics card from the upcoming GeForce RTX 40-series lineup.
